_about: Sera's companions as fighters (scripts/companions.gd, scripts/companion_magic.gd). character: what a companion has on top of their own HP and attack (which come from who they are): base and perLevel stats, as in combat.json's character; xpPerLevel matches the villagers' 30 a level. books: a spell book a companion can be given in a talk (offer: the reply's words; item: the book, taken from Sera's bag; for: the unique it's for; spells: what they learn from it at once; records: chronicle events written; says: their line when there's no scene for it). magic: how a companion casts on their own in a fight: think (seconds between looks), pauseShare (share of a spell's cast time they stand casting, between pauseMin and pauseMax seconds), gap (seconds at least between any two casts), healBelow (share of HP under which Sera or they get a heal), guardAfter (seconds since they were last hit that still counts as being hit, for a barrier), spells: each spell's use (attack, heal or guard); a spell not listed that does damage is used to attack.

books.offer: Give her the Water Spell Book
books.says: It's really it! The water book! Look, it's already making sense... Sera, I can feel it. I can do this!
